description: Always-available router for SynaBun's tool groups. When a task needs a SynaBun tool this runtime does not list, call action="get", then action="add" with the group that has it, and continue once the host refreshes its tools. On Codex and Claude Code every SynaBun tool is already reachable on demand, so there it only moves the focus and needs no reload. Do not report a SynaBun capability unavailable before trying this. A change affects only this runtime, never other sessions or the default for new ones.

action.description: get = this runtime's groups, what they do on this host, and the catalog. add = load more groups for this runtime. set = replace this runtime's groups.

groups.description: Group ids for add and set, from the catalog that get returns, e.g. ["gsc"] or ["browser_whatsapp"]; "all" is every group. The memory tools, loop, tool_groups and choice are always there; agents, skills and computer follow your role and grants.

name: tool_groups
